title: Hosted API regional ratecard & sensitivity workbook
content:
Purpose and scope:
This workbook is a working spreadsheet to synthesize per-region and per-model COGS assumptions for the Hosted API, run sensitivity tests across price points and batching/caching levers, and produce an initial set of optimization recommendations we can action in Q2. Not final — focuses on operational levers we can control (batch config, prefix cache, regional routing) and on cost inputs we need to validate with infra/finance (egress, vendor GPU pass-through, preemptible savings).

Executive summary (working):
- Current baseline estimate: average COGS per 1k generation tokens (weighted across customers) = $0.0034. Unweighted per-call variance huge: 0.0009 -> 0.012 depending on model/region/prompt length.
- Biggest contributors: GPU time (model size & seq length), egress & network (high in APAC), and cross-region replication for KV cache when enabled.
- Top two near-term optimizations with high ROI: 1) aggressive prefix-caching on chat flows (expected -18% avg token COGS), 2) regional routing policy for non-authenticated bulk embedding workloads (expected -12% cost by pushing to cheaper regions).

Assumptions (spreadsheet tabs summarized):
1) RatecardInputs tab - raw inputs we use in sensitivity:
   - GPU-minute rates by region: us-west: $0.75/min, us-east: $0.72/min, eu-west: $0.85/min, ap-south: $1.10/min
   - Egress per GB: us: $0.09, eu: $0.11, apac: $0.15
   - Avg tokens per request (gen): 380 prompt + 320 generated = 700 total
   - KV cache delta: cache-hit reduces decode time by ~45% for many chat flows

2) ModelProfiles tab - per-model decoding throughput and effective tokens/sec (on our inference fleet profiles):
   - rwd-small (base): 2500 tokens/sec, cost per 1k @ us-west: $0.0006
   - rwd-base-8k: 900 tokens/sec, cost per 1k @ us-west: $0.0018
   - rwd-chat-16k: 240 tokens/sec, cost per 1k @ us-west: $0.0046
   - rwd-embed-lite: n/a (embedding BERT-like), cost per 1k tokens equivalent @ us-west: $0.0004
   - NOTE: These are synthesis numbers from infra profiling (PR #1223) and need validation on dedicated node shapes.

3) WorkloadMix tab - sample weighted mixes used in scenarios:
   - PLG app baseline: 60% small-gen, 30% chat-16k, 10% embeddings
   - Enterprise legal: 10% small-gen, 80% chat-16k, 10% long-context summarization
   - Bulk embeddings: 95% embed-lite, 5% small-gen

Sensitivity methodology:
- Sweep variables: price per 1k tokens (public list price), batching factor (1, 4, 16), cache hit rate (0-80%), regional infra rate (-20%..+50% to capture spot vs reserved), egress multiplier (1x..2x).
- Output metrics: gross margin (@current list price), unit COGS, break-even list price for 40% margin target, and incremental savings for proposed levers.

Key sensitivity findings (selected highlights from workbook):
- Batching effect: moving from batching=1 -> batching=16 reduces average GPU per-token cost ~28% for rwd-base-8k, ~22% for chat-16k (due to KV cache interaction). However increased batching increases tail latency; tradeoff acceptable for background/async routes.
- Prefix cache: at 40% cache-hit on chat flows, per-1k COGS falls by ~18% for chat-16k; effective ROI better when combined with aggressive small-model fallbacks.
- Regional delta: APAC costs are ~20-30% higher net of egress; routing bulk embeddings to us regions (when data residency allows) yields immediate savings.
- Egress sensitivity: for long output requests ( > 2MB responses ) egress becomes dominant; margin loss >10pp if egress doubles.

Representative mini-table (textified from sheet):
MODEL, REGION, BASE_COGS_per_1k, BATCH16_COGS_per_1k, CACHE40_COGS_per_1k
chat-16k, us-west, $0.0046, $0.0036, $0.0030
base-8k, us-west, $0.0018, $0.0013, $0.0011
embed-lite, ap-south, $0.0006, $0.0005, $0.0005

Recommendations (actionable items):
1) Short-term (next 6 weeks):
   - Implement per-route batching profiles (async routes default to batch=16, interactive to batch=4) - Owner: infra/sre (INF-4872). Expected savings: 10-20% unit COGS on mixed workloads.
   - Prefix cache pilot for top 5 PLG customers with conversational flows. Instrument cache-hit metrics and latency/miss distributions. Owner: product-hosted-api + applied-ml. Goal: validate 30% hit feasibility.
   - Experiment: route bulk embedding jobs to us-central cheaper pools with opt-in tenant flag. Owner: solutions-engineering.

2) Mid-term (quarter):
   - Introduce region-specific price tiers: list lower price for US vs APAC for heavy-embedding customers; automate routing to cheapest allowed region. Finance to model SLA implications.
   - Add egress-aware pricing: for customers with high outbound, introduce discounted compute + egress pass-through so margin protected.

3) Longer-term:
   - Invest in model quantization pipeline for chat-16k variants (expected -18% GPU time on decode).
   - Consider reserve pool for high-volume embeders (dedicated capacity) with committed usage to beat hosted marginal costs.

Open questions / validation tasks:
- Confirm GPU-minute rates for APAC reserved nodes (finance to provide contract line items).
- Validate effective tokens/sec for rwd-chat-16k on quantized kernels (applied-ml measurement).
- Get egress precise measurement per customer by route (console telemetry).

To-dos (owners & dates):
- INF-4872: infra implements adjustable batching knobs per route — assigned to Jonah Perez — due 2025-03-01
- OPT-731: product & applied-ml run prefix-cache pilot with 5 customers — assigned to Maya Thompson & Rahul — due 2025-03-15
- FIN-90: finance provide region cost-breakdown and committed discounts — assigned to Sofia Nguyen — due 2025-02-25

Notes & rough calculations (copied from sheet formulas):
- Unit COGS per_1k = (GPU_minutes_per_1k * GPU_rate_region + egress_per_1k + s3_read_cost + misc_overhead) * infra_margin_adj
- GPU_minutes_per_1k = (1 / tokens_per_second) * 1000 / 60, adjusted by decode vs total time fractions and by cache hit reduction factor.

Appendix: quick sensitivity snapshots (rounded)
- Baseline PLG mix @ current price -> gross margin 41%
- With batch=16 + cache40 -> gross margin 54%
- If APAC infra + egress spikes + no batching -> gross margin 29%

Where this doc lives and next steps:
- This is the shared working workbook for the Optimize PM + product-hosted-api owners. Please update the sheet tabs (RatecardInputs, ModelProfiles, WorkloadMix, Scenarios) with new numbers rather than editing the summary text.
- Post pilot, we should lock a canonical set of per-model COGS profiles to use in pricing conversations and partner proposals.

Rough provenance and assumptions log:
- infra GPU profiling: PR #1223 (linked)
- earlier token-econ workbench used as baseline, but this file reorganizes by region and adds explicit egress modeling and batching interactions. Intentionally different from token-econ-workbench: more region-first, includes egress as first-class input, and explicit batching/load-tail tradeoffs.
